stories.title: The latest AI news we announced in September 2026
stories.explanation: Google announced several AI updates from September 2026, including the release of the Gemini 4 Argon model, new Connected Apps in the Gemini App, and WeatherNext 3. These updates enhance Google's AI capabilities and product offerings.

stories.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
stories.explanation: OpenAI released a guide for startups on how to effectively use and manage their GPT-6 models, offering practical tips for optimizing performance and cost. This helps users get the best results from OpenAI's advanced models.

stories.title: Anthropic invests $100 million to train 10,000 engineers and tackle the enterprise AI talent gap
stories.explanation: Anthropic is investing $100 million to launch Claude Frontier Academy, aiming to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027. This initiative addresses the enterprise AI talent gap by equipping engineers with critical skills.

stories.title: How NVIDIA GPUs Help Accelerate OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast
stories.explanation: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast, running on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, delivers up to 8x faster token generation for various applications. This collaboration provides developers with faster model responses for improved efficiency.

stories.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB Gives Developers More Ways to Build and Scale Local AI
stories.explanation: NVIDIA is releasing DGX Spark 64GB, a new configuration that allows developers to build and scale local AI agents on-device with the full NVIDIA AI stack. This provides a complete local AI platform for various development needs.

stories.title: OpenAI’s Dot agent is enterprise software that can also order your dinner
stories.explanation: OpenAI launched Dot, a new consumer AI agent aimed at business use cases but also capable of assisting with personal tasks, expanding ChatGPT's functionality.

stories.title: Open-sourcing AstaBrief, the fast report-generation model in Asta
stories.explanation: Ai2 open-sourced AstaBrief, a fast report-generation model designed to help scientists create cited reports more quickly. This allows researchers to download and run the model themselves for scientific work.

stories.title: Judge dismisses Chegg and Penske antitrust lawsuits targeting Google AI search
stories.explanation: A US federal judge dismissed antitrust lawsuits by Chegg and Penske Media against Google regarding its AI search features. The ruling states Google's conduct is not illegal under antitrust law, impacting publishers concerned about traffic loss from AI overviews.

stories.title: Call it AI, call it Super Intelligence, only 2% of consumers are buying it
stories.explanation: The White House is rebranding AI as 'super intelligence' and held an AI safety pledge event with major tech CEOs, while consumer AI faces economic challenges despite enterprise investment.

stories.title: These AI Experts Want to Do High-Stakes Research Out in the Open
stories.explanation: Trillium Labs, a new nonprofit founded by Nathan Lambert and Tom Zick, aims to conduct high-stakes AI research, including recursive self-improvement and agents, transparently by publishing experiment details.
